All 4 in one tab on OpenClips. Try it now.

originalPrompt: Cinematic 10-second shot in an elegant Art Deco cocktail bar at night, warm golden light, dark green velvet and brass. A tall champagne tower of crystal coupe glasses, six levels, stands on a marble bar. A young waitress in a black satin dress stands beside it holding a gold-foil champagne bottle and slowly pours into the top glass; champagne overflows and cascades down the levels, sparkling in the light. Camera slowly pushes in at eye level. Halfway through, one glass on the bottom row slips out of place and the whole tower wobbles, leans and topples over in dramatic slow motion: the glasses tumble and roll across the marble bar, champagne splashes everywhere in a golden spray, bubbles and droplets catch the light. She freezes with the bottle still raised, eyes wide in surprise, then bursts into laughter and covers her mouth with her free hand. Playful, glamorous, realistic physics of glass and liquid, photorealistic, shallow depth of field.
